openings.claim: The incumbent's tags identify materials but may leave pattern-specific quantities dependent on memory. Rare sample consultation and shared-material omissions support this explanation, without establishing where omissions occur. O4 challenges any claim that shared tagged trays are necessary for accuracy.
openings.delta: Develop the existing sample-and-tag mechanism by pencilling the assigned pattern and required quantities on each envelope, then ticking each quantity only after insertion. The exterior pattern also makes assignment visible at distribution. Retain specified quantities and dimensions, existing supplies, two volunteers and the existing table.
openings.prediction: With matched pattern mixtures and unchanged shared-tray layout, envelope-specific counts and insertion ticks reduce omissions; exterior pattern marks reduce assignment exchanges. Total time including checking may still exceed 90 minutes.
openings.rival_prediction: Spatial interference during picking is the nearest alternative. It predicts that private loose staging reduces crossings, time and omissions, while envelope cues with shared trays provide little improvement.
openings.defeat: A matched-mixture counterexample reproducing O4's zero omissions without envelope cues, while recipe-marked shared-tray kits still omit items and cross-reaches remain frequent, would defeat quantity-memory as the dominant explanation. Correctly ticked but incomplete envelopes would specifically defeat the proposed insertion-check mechanism.
openings.probe: Within an 18-minute cap including preparation and audit, have the same two volunteers alternate three four-kit batches: incumbent shared trays, marked-and-ticked envelopes with shared trays, and loose local staging without quantity cues. Match pattern mix and quantities; use existing tally sheets to record crossings, preparation, assembly, checking and omissions. Audit contents against samples. Stop if staging cannot fit the table. These authored observations motivate the probe; no improvement is established.
assumptions: Envelope space permits legible pattern and quantity marks.
Loose staging fits the table; its footprint is unverified.
The matched probe is feasible within its cap; completing all 60 accurate kits within 90 minutes remains unproven.
O4's pattern mixture is unknown; its result cannot yet identify the cause.
